scope: Close the continuous initial owner geometry and controls from the canonical owner JSON, the exact source Def, and the three already generated XML files. The native samples remain discrete diagnostics; no production BI4, H5, VTK, solver, or ledger is read or changed.

owner_authority.source_policy: The owner JSON is the continuous geometry authority. Its mass is computed from the closed reservoir box and density; native sample mass is not substituted or rescaled.

source_geometry_rule.source_fluid_comment: v1 fallback controlled fluid cell centres
source_geometry_rule.medium_drawbox_relation: source fluid drawbox equals owner box inset by dp/2 on each face
source_geometry_rule.other_grid_policy: The three source fluid drawbox primitives are byte-level equal in geometry; changing definition dp changes only the discrete lattice resolution. Effective selected-particle support remains a separate native-position validation gate.

minimum_next_native_validation.purpose: Validate the effective initial selected-particle support against the closed owner box without interpreting neighboring-grid differences as truth.
required_checks: all fluid positions finite and within owner box with a separately recorded binary/position tolerance
no fluid position overlaps the disjoint divider interval
fluid role and native MK mapping agree with the generated XML ranges
native mass and count are reported separately from the 340 kg continuous owner mass
source pre/post SHA and complete stat remain stable after the parent reservation
minimum_next_native_validation.payload_policy: One frame per grid only; no solver launch, no full native tree, no H5/VTK, no mass rescale.
